messages:
maya (product): FYI, big payments customer requested a 'telemetry recall' + certified export bundle: pull convos + request traces by user_id/convo_id for up to 90 days, 24h export SLA, and BYOK for exported archives. they9re asking if we can include a tamper-evident proof and who requested it. can we scope this for the compliance roadmap?
lee (security): security view: must include chain-of-custody (requestor identity, token, IP, timestamp), signed manifest (SHA256 per file, plus a merkle root if we want efficiency), and audit of export access. retention enforcement needs tamper-evidence (immutable logs or signed attestations).
toni (legal): legal notes: exports must carry provenance metadata and a retention statement for contracts. we also need a legal-hold toggle so TTLs can be overridden for e-discovery. can9t commit enterprise SLAs before pricing and infra capacity analysis.
alex (sales): customer will fund a compliance add-on. they want timeline and pilot. they9d accept phased delivery: 30d recall + manual export → 90d + automated 24h SLA.
sam (eng): engineering breakdown: 1) index telemetry by tenant,user_id,convo_id 2) export pipeline + on-demand API 3) signed manifest generator 4) BYOK support for export storage. rough estimates: MVP (30d recall + nightly exports) = ~6w with 2 engs. on-demand 24h SLA and performance tuning = +3-4w. need extra storage and query infra. sample retention config: ```json
{
  "tenant_id": "acme-pay",
  "retention": { "mode": "sliding", "days": 30 },
  "legal_hold": false
}
```
jamie (customer success): ops ask: create an ops runbook for manual exports during pilot and a request approval flow for sensitive exports. also recommend offering 30d and 90d tiers to unblock deals.
maya (product): proposed MVP scope to commit in roadmap: - 30-day configurable recall per tenant - per-tenant export API (request-based) - signed manifest with file hashes + issuer metadata - 48h export SLA for MVP (goal: 24h for GA) - BYOK export pilot (opt-in) gating for public launch: signed manifests + ops runbook + pilot customer. owners: sam (tech), toni (legal), jamie (ops), alex (pilot). target pilot ~8w.
lee (security): +1 on scope. require manifest to include requestor identity, auth token hash, and request IP. plan threat model review on sam9s design.
sam (eng): will draft PRD + tech design and post by EOW. request two engineers for 6 weeks to hit MVP. i'll include cost estimates for storage/egress.
toni (legal): will circulate export contract language and legal-hold wording by Tue.
alex (sales): i'll scope pilot customer and budget this week; prefer a 30d+pilot pitch to start.
maya (product): action checklist: sam (PRD+design), toni (legal copy), jamie (ops runbook), alex (pilot confirmation). marking as customer-driven compliance add-on in roadmap. tagging @security-team for review when design is ready.
security-team: acknowledged. we'll schedule threat modeling once the design doc is up.
